attributes.residual: THE UNCAPPED SWEEP, and the false-positive class it exposed in the screen itself. Lifting the <=8-byte scalar cap took the image-wide finding set from 7 functions to 21 over 257 paired units, and this record's fix is one of two at `real` 0 (the other is attempt.CV_fn-8005a868-name-entry-placeholder-string-drew-nothing.20260903.v1). THE NEW FALSE-POSITIVE CLASS IS THE SECTION-SYMBOL BASE: where the target relocates against a named string symbol and adds a displacement to reach a LATER string, our compiler relocates against the .rodata SECTION alias and adds a different displacement to reach the SAME string. Both address identical storage, and the datum key - which reads the symbol's own bytes - reads a different string on each side. MEASURED, game/game/player::do_got_it_8007FC80: target `addi r28,r6,lbl_80113AE0@l` then +1784/+1796/+1808/+1820/+1832, ours `addi r28,r6,...rodata.0@l` then +456/+468/+480/+492/+504 - a CONSTANT delta of 1328 at every site, so the two bases differ by 1328 and every reference lands on the same datum. The same alias explains create_player_blits, setup_player_display and write_health_and_items ('trbo_full_new' against '16_%sCOIN'), and it is the same mechanism attempt.CB_screen-limitation-string-size-audit-and-reloc-arbiter-bounds.20260901.v1 already refuted for combat::screen_limitation ('CONTAINER' against 'CAM: %.2f'). A screen over aggregate datums must therefore exclude section-alias bases or check the displacement delta; the scalar-capped form has no such class, which is why the capped sweep's 7 rows were all decidable and the uncapped 21 are not. TWO LIVE CANDIDATES REFERRED, both inside another lane's ACTIVE claim this run and therefore NOT touched: game/boss/boss::ProcessSpewItems (real 119, ours-only f32 0.1 where the target references only the f64 0.1 - a literal-suffix candidate) belongs to claude-fleet-worker-BG per work_claim.reconstruction.20260903.v1; game/audio/audio::AudioStreamPlay (real 88, target-only 'Audio Play Timeout' against ours-only 'Audio Stream bad file: %s' - two DIFFERENT diagnostics, not a length difference) belongs to claude-fleet-worker-NC per work_claim.close-round-9.20260903.v1. ONE MATCHING LEVER, not a defect: game/enemy/critter::CritterAnimInterrupt (real 204) loads the target-only f32 0.5 into f1 immediately before `bl CritterDamagePlayer` at +0x518, i.e. a first-FPR argument our call does not pass; the callee is NOT a victim, because its own prologue overwrites f1 at +0x2c (`lfs f1,44(r5)`) before reading it, so this is the knr-extern-arity phantom-parameter family and a count lever for a matching lane, not a behaviour bug.

hypothesis.statement: The scalar-capped datum-VALUE set screen belongs in the tool corpus as a standing correctness gate, because it is the only screen in the project that sees a wrong constant inside a byte-identical function, and both of run 49's real defects were invisible to every other arbiter. The shape that measured clean: keys from fndiff.datum_key restricted to B: values of at most 8 bytes, compared as SETS (a count difference is a CSE fact - camera_mode_follow loads 0.6 three times in the target and once in ours), differences filtered through fndiff._datum_prefix_equal (this removes 49 of 56 rows, all pure dtk-granularity), ranked by `real` ASCENDING. tools/gdl is claude-fleet-worker-T19's claimed scope this run, so this lane did NOT promote its script; the working copy is CV_scratch/cv_scalar_datum_sweep.py and the algorithm above is complete enough to re-derive it.
